$comment: Design tokens. THE source of truth for colour and type in the native apps.
Edit here, then run `node brand/scripts/generate-tokens.mjs` to regenerate
Never edit those two files — they are generated and will be overwritten.
Values and names mirror apps/web/src/global.css, which is where this palette
was designed (in OKLCH, then translated to hex — the oklch() comments there
are the real provenance). The web app is NOT yet generated from this file, so
the two can still drift. Wiring web up to emit its custom properties from here
Colours are light/dark pairs, matching CSS light-dark(). Both platforms
resolve them from the system appearance automatically.

opacity.$comment: --toner in global.css: a neutral wash used for dividers and inset surfaces.

type.$comment: lineHeight is the total line box at defaultSize. The generator emits the ratio so it holds when the reader is zoomed.
